causes.quote: High demand, which peaked at 9,146 MW- the highest up to that point of the summer.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Most of the reduced capacity was known and related to Callide B, Callide C, and Gladstone.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: CleanCo's Swanbank unit removed 350 MW of capacity at 11.24 am due to a 'plant trip'. Alinta Energy's Braemar 3 unit failed to start at 4.53 pm removing 172 MW of capacity.

causes.label: solar_output
causes.quote: Falling solar generation further reduced the available supply of low-priced generation for the evening peak demand

causes.quote: A system normal constraint limited imports from NSW on the Queensland-New South Wales Interconnector (QNI), further limiting Queensland's access to low-priced generation.
